title: Reflection property of the principal Koszul Roos complex
statement: Let C be a small site and R a sheaf of commutative rings with exact countable products of module sheaves. Choose the module derived category and all slice derived categories in the same universe. Let a be a global section whose multiplication on the unit module is mono, and let P be any cochain complex. The strict principal Koszul Roos complex is locally derived (a)-complete [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. For every locally derived (a)-complete derived object L, composition with the localized principalKoszulRoosUnit [lem-pur-principal-koszul-roos-presentation-comparison] gives a bijection Hom(Q(H(V)),L) ≃ Hom(Q(P),L).

source.place: Tags 099B and 0A0E, completion as reflection and its finite Koszul model; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0941.

proof.text: The faithful degree-zero embedding in the given derived category makes module sheaves locally small in the required morphism universe. Natural transformations between inverse towers inject into the countable product of their component Hom types. K-injective resolutions then show that the tower derived category exists in that same universe: morphisms into a K-injective representative are quotients of small chain-map types. Module sheaves and their inverse-tower category are Grothendieck abelian, the latter by evaluation left adjoints applied to a separator.

On each slice, the unit sheaf has a generating singleton section: its free evaluation is split epic by the identity section. The multiplication map carries that section to a, so this is an ideal-generating list. Apply the existing ringed Koszul reflector with this list, obtaining a normalized presentation D, completeness of D.completion(Q(P)) and its universal Hom bijection.

Use the principal presentation comparison to identify the strict Roos complex with D.completion(Q(P)), compatibly with the unit. Restriction and internal Hom preserve isomorphisms, so the local vanishing conditions transport. Composition with the comparison isomorphism is a bijection on Hom, transporting the reflector bijection to exactly the specified principal Roos unit.

theorem principalKoszulRoos_reflector
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [∀ V : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (J.over V) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (R.over V)))]
    [HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    (a : (SheafOfModules.unit
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)).sections)
    (_ha : Mono (globalSectionMultiplication R a))
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ) :
    IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete R
      (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
      (globalSectionMultiplication R a)
      (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj
        (roosF.obj (koszulTowerComplex R (koszulTensorTower R P a)))) ∧
    ∀ L, IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete R
        (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
        (globalSectionMultiplication R a) L →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj
          (roosF.obj (koszulTowerComplex R (koszulTensorTower R P a))) ⟶ L ↦
        DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map (principalKoszulRoosUnit R P a) ≫ f)
